findings.evidence: `BialgEquiv.symm_apply_apply` at mathlib/Mathlib/RingTheory/Bialgebra/Equiv.lean:280; the sibling lemma `gaScalarTensorBialgEquiv_symm_ι` (BaseChange.lean:191-201) already uses this pattern instead of a `change`.
findings.fix: Mirror the proof already used at lines 191-201: `have h : symmetricAlgebraBialgEquiv (K := K) e (ι K P (e.symm n)) = ι K N n := by rw [symmetricAlgebraBialgEquiv_ι, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]` then `rw [← h, BialgEquiv.symm_apply_apply]`.
findings.issue: `change` crosses the `BialgEquiv.ofAlgEquiv` wrapper by definitional equality; the comment records that it is defeq but not why no lemma-based route exists — one does.

findings.evidence: Lines 158-161: no goal is discharged by a named characteristic lemma; the closing `simp only` succeeds only because both sides reduce to `map R e.symm.toLinearMap a` after unfolding the definition.
findings.fix: Prove it from the characteristic equations rather than the definition, e.g. `apply AlgEquiv.coe_toAlgHom_injective; apply algHom_ext; ext a; simp [AlgEquiv.symm_apply_eq]`, so it survives any refactor of `mapEquiv`.
findings.issue: `mapEquiv_symm` is proved by unfolding `mapEquiv` twice (`rw [mapEquiv]`, then `simp only [..., mapEquiv, ...]`) and closing on definitional equality of two `AlgEquiv.ofAlgHom` bundles; the pointwise `AlgEquiv.ext`/`intro a` plays no role and there is no comment.

findings.evidence: `LinearEquiv.coe_trans : (e₁₂.trans e₂₃ : M₁ →ₛₗ M₃) = e₂₃.comp e₁₂` at mathlib/Mathlib/Algebra/Module/Equiv/Defs.lean:346 (and `comp_coe`, simp, at :407) is the statement of `h` at lines 183-185.
findings.fix: Drop both `have`s: `apply AlgEquiv.coe_toAlgHom_injective; apply algHom_ext; ext a; simp` reduces the statement to `mapEquiv_ι`; otherwise use `LinearEquiv.coe_trans`/`comp_coe` instead of reproving it.
findings.issue: `mapEquiv_trans` inlines two general facts unrelated to symmetric algebras: `htrans` (an `AlgEquiv.trans`/`toAlgHom` law) and `h`, which is exactly Mathlib's `LinearEquiv.coe_trans`.

findings.evidence: Lines 93-98 and 102-107 are the same five-line `have hmaps ... AlgHom.congr_fun` script; `map_leftInverse` instantiated at `f := g, g := f` takes exactly the hypothesis `f.comp g = LinearMap.id`.
findings.issue: `map_rightInverse` repeats `map_leftInverse`'s proof verbatim with `f`/`g` swapped; `Function.RightInverse (map R g) (map R f)` is by definition `Function.LeftInverse (map R f) (map R g)`.

findings.evidence: `AlgHom.commutes` is `@[simp]` at mathlib/Mathlib/Algebra/Algebra/Hom.lean:202-203; the goal is `map R f (algebraMap R _ r) = algebraMap R _ r`.
findings.issue: The `algebraMap` branch of `map_surjective` unfolds the definition (`simp [map]`) where the bundled `AlgHom` API already closes the goal, exposing the proof to `lift`'s internals.

summary: Several proofs work by unfolding the new definitions or by re-deriving general library facts inline, and one bridges a BialgEquiv wrapper by definitional equality when the same file already demonstrates a wrapper-free route. Fixes are local: prove the equivalence laws from the characteristic generator equations.
